description: Obiectul contractului: : furnizarea de: Autovehicul de patrulare plug in hybrid (minim 6+1 locuri), Terminal comunicații prin satelit, Aparat de vedere pe timp de noapte, Echipamente de salvare şi supravuiţuire pentru echipaje, GPS portabil și Remorcă auto pentru transport ATV și livrarea acestora la sediul autorităţii contractante (UM 0716 Baia Mare – Inspectoratul de Jandarmi Județean Maramureș) În urma analizării la nivelul Inspectoratului de Jandarmi Județean Maramureș a nivelului dotării și capacității de intervenție în domeniul protejării biodiversității naturale, s-a constatat necesitatea achiziționării unor echipamente și mijloace specifice pentru executarea misiunilor în siguranță de către personalul Inspectoratului de Jandarmi Județean Maramureș, pentru atingerea obiectivului de consolidare a protecției și conservării naturii, biodiversității, infrastructurii verzi, și silviculturii în zona transfrontalieră româno-ucraineană. Obiectiv specific este consolidarea protecției și conservării naturii, biodiversității, infrastructurii verzi, și silviculturii în zona transfrontalieră româno-ucraineană. Scopul achiziției este îndeplinirea obiectivului proiectului prin sporirea dotarii și pregătirii personalului operativ în vederea dezvoltării unor strategii inovatoare pentru consolidarea supravegherii, controlului, conservării și protejării fondului forestier, în scopul protejării biodiversității. Astfel, prin achiziționarea echipamentelor se va reduce timpul de reacție, respectiv deplasarea forțelor în timp util și eficient și supravegherea în bune condiții a zonei de interes, sporind eficiența forțelor de ordine implicate. title: JOINT IMPLEMENTATION OF SAT-3 AND COGNITIVE CLOUD COMPUTING IN SPACE (EOCOGNITIVELAB)
description: EOCognitiveLab brings together the evolution of the sat mission series and ESA's work on Cognitive Cloud Computing in Space for Earth Observation (3CS4EO). The activity is intended to demonstrate the added values unlocked by AI-enabled, cooperative Earth Observation capabilities across multiple heterogeneous?satellites?(including, event-based acquisition replanning, coordinated acquisitions), onboard processing and inter-satellite-link information exchange,?for selected end-to-end Earth Observation use cases, and to establish an in-orbit laboratory for autonomous, distributed and software-defined Earth Observation missions.? The mission will be based on a cooperative two-satellite space segment, equipped with onboard computing capabilities, supported by ground processing, and an exploitation platform enabling data distribution and community access. In addition, EOCognitiveLab will leverage open inter-satellite-link interfaces and be designed to support future expansion through the federation of additional Earth Observation missions.? As an in-orbit laboratory, EOCognitiveLab will provide an open and expandable environment for additional in-orbit experimentation forESA Members, Associated and Cooperating States EO community. Target experimentation areas include cooperative sensing, distributed processing, novel mission-orchestration approaches, onboard federated learning and fine-tuning, and other AI techniques relevant to distributed Earth Observation systems.? The proposed?activity will be implemented through a Mission Consolidation Phase followed, subject to a successful Gate Review, by a Mission Implementation Phase covering detailed design, development, integration, verification, launch, LEOP, commissioning and in-orbit verification up to the In-Orbit Commissioning Review.

description: To assess the cyclic aero-thermo-mechanical loads, for reusable space transportation systems andthe impact of those loads on the operational lifetime.DescriptionWhen exploiting reusability for transportation vehicles, their lifetime and cost estimation depends on (sub)systems undergoing both low (ascent and re-entry) and high-cyclic loads (vibrations, aerodynamics, thermal) which impacts their lifetime of the used materials and equipment.Currently, no general guidelines or requirements are in place to allow the designer to anticipate thetype of materials to be used in the design, the impact on the performance, cost, etc. Therefore, ageneric approach is needed to lay out the basics for a properly defined system analysis.The activity is aimed to be generic and cover a wide range of reusable concepts. Preparing the basis for the ECSS handbooks and standardsupdates w.r.t. reusability.This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Definition of reusable vehicles and their missions in a generic way, covering a wide rangeof conceptual designs and applications.- As the loads differ a lot pending on the ascent and return trajectory, the cyclic loads andtheir impact shall be derived for launchers based on VTVL, VTHL, HTHL. For re-entryvehicles, this is based upon sub-l and super orbital trajectories. Generic vehicles and trajectories are aimed to be used.- Definition of static and cycling loads.- The respective loads and their cycles are aimed to be derived along with variations covering both the external (stagnation regions, surfaces, control surfaces..) as well as the internal flow path i.e. the propulsion units (injectors, combustors, throats, nozzles etc...).discrimination is made for the type of vehicle and the kind of propulsion unit (e.g. liquid, solid, electrical, airbreathing...)-sessment of the dimensioning loads.- A first assessment is aimed to be made upon the sizing loads, both for the internal and external flow paths for the full range of investigated space vehicles in T1. The most dimensioning ones are investigated in more detail and applied on the related vehicles, necessary during a first design loop- Updates of ECSS handbooks and standards.- A generic layout of a handbook drafted making maximum use of the layout of existing handbooks w.r.t. expandable vehicles. Complement them and prepare the design approach for various classes of reusable vehicles.Procurement Policy: C(2) = A relevant participation (in terms of quality and quantity) of non-primes (incl.
